body: Tested on 4.4 dev 4 (the first version with pr #97094), `LineEdit.edit()` triggers the signal but `LineEdit.unedit()` not, so i'll ping the pr author to check if this is intended or a bug. CC @WhalesState

This fixes the issue, I have removed the lines calling the signal after using `unedit()` and i emitted it inside the method.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fddb37a0-e80f-4418-822b-69f7e9984827)

Edit:
Maybe we can do the same for `edit()` too.
I also have found that it should only emit `editing_toggled` signal when focus is grabbed by mouse, there's no way to only grab focus in select mode unless we focus it with arrow keys.

Here's a commit that fixes it by making `grab_focus()` only calls `edit()` when focused with mouse, makes it usable to only grab focus without entering edit mode, on the other hand using `edit()` will call `grab_focus()` if it's not focused and will not enter edit mode unless we call `edit()` or we focus it with mouse button, also i have replaced all editor LineEdit grab_focus() calls with edit() after this change.

Please check if any other files in master has changed and is using grab_focus() then replace it with `edit()`.
Search all files that contains `memnew(LineEdit)`, `memnew(SpinBox)` or `memnew(EditorSpinSlider)` and search for `grab_focus`.
